title: 数据与标签血缘
formula: 迟到率=晚于冻结标签数/到达标签数；PIT违规单列
physicalSql: SELECT run_id,dataset_hash,policy_hash,role,source_commit,source_revision,from_ordinal,through_ordinal,contract_hash,status,summary_json FROM r30r1_analysis_run ORDER BY recorded_at DESC,run_id
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 样本特征支持域
fields: feature/ABI,窗口,缺失/finite/支持数,分布版本
formula: null_rate=缺失/应有；多位置不作独立期
physicalSql: SELECT atom_id,dataset_hash,n_select,missing_rate,state,definition,computed_at FROM r27_atom_score ORDER BY atom_id
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 事前预测与结构落地
formula: 同目标proper loss；预测必须先于标签
physicalSql: SELECT policy_hash,target_issue,target_ordinal,position,probabilities,frozen_at,deadline_at,hit,settled_at,'FUTURE_READ_ONLY' AS role FROM r27_live_frozen ORDER BY target_ordinal DESC,policy_hash
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 失败机制样本
formula: 失败覆盖数/合法应测期；机制hash去重
physicalSql: SELECT run_id,measure_key,kind,parent_hash,from_ordinal,to_ordinal,payload_json FROM r30r1_research_measure WHERE kind IN ('FAILURE_PRESCRIPTION','FAILURE_MEMORY','STRUCTURE_FORECAST_ERROR') ORDER BY run_id,measure_key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 原子配对贡献
physicalSql: SELECT run_id,measure_key,parent_hash,from_ordinal,to_ordinal,evaluated_calendar_issues,mean_gain,lower95,upper95,payload_json FROM r30r1_research_measure WHERE kind='ATOM_PAIRED_GAIN' ORDER BY run_id,measure_key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 分子协同与复杂度
physicalSql: SELECT run_id,measure_key,parent_hash,payload_json FROM r30r1_research_measure WHERE kind='MOLECULE_SYNERGY' ORDER BY run_id,measure_key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 族与行为指纹
formula: 重复率=同probe近同输出/新候选；机制覆盖
physicalSql: SELECT dataset_hash,probe_set_hash,signature,kept_policy,dropped_policy,stage,recorded_at FROM r30_behavior_dup ORDER BY recorded_at DESC,kept_policy,dropped_policy
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 专家到AST处方
formula: 可执行落地率=合法AST子代/提案；不计文本条数
physicalSql: SELECT generation,expert,proposal_json,policy_hash,recorded_at FROM r27_expert_proposal ORDER BY generation DESC,expert
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 算子与父子预算
formula: 效益与CPU分列，固定成本桶；不造综合神分
physicalSql: SELECT r.run_id,r.role,r.policy_hash,m.measure_key,m.kind,m.mean_gain,m.payload_json FROM r30r1_analysis_run r JOIN r30r1_research_measure m ON m.run_id=r.run_id WHERE m.kind IN ('OPERATOR_COST','PARENT_CHILD_GAIN','RESEARCH_BUDGET') ORDER BY r.recorded_at DESC,m.measure_key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 融合互补证据
formula: 同目标残差相关；Δ_fused vs same-budget baseline
physicalSql: SELECT run_id,measure_key,parent_hash,payload_json FROM r30r1_research_measure WHERE kind='FUSION_COMPLEMENTARITY' ORDER BY run_id,measure_key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 神经训练与消费链
formula: 计数按position sample/访问/独立期分列；模型消费率=合法调用/应调用
physicalSql: SELECT target_ordinal,position,model_hash,history_hash,probabilities,probability_hash,trained_through_ordinal,model_available_at,feature_through_ordinal,frozen_at,deadline_at FROM r30_model_surface ORDER BY target_ordinal DESC,position,model_hash
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 校准支持与风险
physicalSql: SELECT key AS policy_hash,payload_json,updated_at FROM r27_chart_cache WHERE panel_id='calibration-r30' ORDER BY key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 确认/未来/资格证据
formula: hit/ACT、ACT/机会；区间仅描述；正式授证沿注册合同
physicalSql: SELECT task_key,policy_hash,dataset_hash,block_id,state,verified,registration_state,registration_experiment_id,packet_json,result_json,'FORMAL_READ_ONLY' AS role FROM r30_frozen_confirm ORDER BY created_at DESC,task_key
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 研究任务活性与公平
formula: 积压年龄=当前日历期−最老pending期；无pending为null
physicalSql: SELECT p.*,t.lane,t.status,t.blocked_reason FROM r30r1_task_progress p LEFT JOIN r26_task t ON t.task_id=p.task_id ORDER BY p.task_id
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 处方消费与增量效果
formula: 消费闭环率=唯一已消费/可消费；有效性另行独立评估
physicalSql: SELECT p.proposal_id,p.run_id,p.parent_hash,p.kind,p.payload_json,p.state,p.reason,c.child_policy_hash,c.source_generation,c.consumer_version,c.receipt_hash,c.consumed_at FROM r30r1_proposal p LEFT JOIN r30r1_consume c ON c.proposal_id=p.proposal_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.proposal_id
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged

title: 自然资产主链与资源成本
formula: 净结果=实际结算收入−实际成本；预测命中与经济收益分列
source: 原唯一REAL/结算账本+消费链只读join
consumer: R18最终效果；无真实赔付不计算经济盈利
physicalSql: SELECT issue,decision_key,entry_point,original_allow,original_reason,certificate_active,items_json,source_json,recorded_at,'FORMAL_READ_ONLY' AS role FROM r30_decision_explain ORDER BY recorded_at DESC,issue
schemaOwner: SchemaR27 original writer; original data owners unchanged
